annotations.title: Check whether the gap between lines will stay open

description: Use when the user gives a line width and the gap between two lines or letters in millimetres and asks whether the gap will stay open as the tattoo ages. Applies the published rule of thumb that a line widens by about 0.1 mm per decade: returns the line width and gap after the given number of years (default 20), whether the gap meets the guides' 'at least as wide as the line' rule, and what the guide's worked example would do to it. Illustrative arithmetic, not a measurement.

gap_mm.description: Width of the space between the two lines or letters, in millimetres.

line_width_mm.description: Width of the line in millimetres, as drawn today (for example 0.3 fine line, 1.5 bold outline).
